name: math-modeling-suite
description: A mathematical modeling suite with explicit Python execution, LaTeX paper production, and staged verification.

interface.shortDescription: Staged modeling with Python and LaTeX
interface.longDescription: Route work through preflight, problem-analysis, data-analysis, model-construction, model-solving, visualization, validation, paper-writing, and paper-production, with a read-only method library.
defaultPrompt: Use $math-modeling-orchestrator to route this problem through preflight, problem-analysis, data-analysis when required, model-construction, model-solving, visualization when required, validation, paper-writing when requested, and paper-production when requested; consult the read-only method library for maintained methods.
